name: cmdb_cientity_attr_metric
label: CMDB Configuration Item Attribute Performance Data Table
description: Configuration item attribute performance data table - records numeric attribute performance data submitted by configuration item transactions.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records.

indexes.name: idx_cientity_attr_time
indexes.description: An ordinary index covering the fields `client_id`, `attr_id`, and `metric_time` is suitable for querying time series data of a single configuration item attribute.

indexes.name: idx_attr_time
indexes.description: An ordinary index covering the `attr_id` and `metric_time` fields is suitable for querying performance data by attribute and time.
